parsed.name: R&S CMU200 音频分析仪
parsed.description: 用于实验室音频信号分析的仪器，可通过 SCPI 进行控制，执行或获取音频分析主测量的状态/结果，用于音频质量评估与相关测试。
parsed.description_en: A laboratory instrument for audio signal analysis, controllable via SCPI to run or fetch the status/results of primary audio analysis measurements for audio quality evaluation and related testing.

actions.description: 执行或获取主音频分析测量的状态/结果。
actions.description_en: Run or fetch the status/results of the primary audio analysis measurement.
